description: Deltares Global Water Availability is a dataset listed in Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue, a cloud catalogue of environmental and geospatial data sets, published or maintained by Deltares. Deltares has produced a hydrological model approach to simulate historical daily reservoir variations for 3,236 locations across the globe for the period 1970-2020 using the distributed wflowsbm model. The model outputs long-term daily information on reservoir volume, inflow and outflow dynamics, as well as information on upstream hydrological forcing. Coverage: simulated daily reservoir volume, inflow and outflow at 3,236 reservoirs worldwide, 1970 to 2020. The catalogue entry lists assets named data, index, reachable through the STAC API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CDLA-Permissive-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure exposure, hazard and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-planetary-computer-catalogue.
